voice.name: Open Sector - He 111
voice.description: Male bomber crew captain in his early forties, methodical and businesslike over the intercom, steady even mid-low voice with a crisp precise northern accent, sounds like an engineer reading a checklist, dry understated humor, never hurries, everything by the book.
voice.sample: Crew, checklist. Altitude fifty meters, speed two hundred and sixty, bearing one-four-zero. Torpedo armed. Navigator, confirm the target. Good. We do this once, and we do it properly.

ready: He 111 crew on board. Torpedo secured.
die: That was not on the checklist.

fire.prompt: Air-dropped torpedo released from a bomber with a mechanical clunk, falling with a short whoosh and splashing heavily into the sea, then a running torpedo motor whirring underwater, no music, no voice

move.prompt: WWII twin-engine bomber flying overhead, deep throbbing unsynchronized propeller engine drone with doppler fly-by, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Twin-engine bomber shot down, engines sputtering and smoking, whining descent and crash with explosion and breaking metal, outdoors, no music, no voice
